title: Before and After Puzzle
description: Given a list of phrases, find all unique 'before and after' puzzles formed by joining two phrases where the last word of the first equals the first word of the last.
pseudocode:
1. Store phrases in a map: first_word -> list of indices
2. Iterate through each phrase as the 'second' phrase
3. Find the last word of the 'first' phrase
4. If first_word of current phrase matches, combine and add to result
5. Sort and return unique puzzles
